title: Opening the address of a deleted Part Library entry says it is not found
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a Part Library entry with no part behind it for this test, entry A: create a part at the test location, then delete it, so the entry stays with "Total parts" 0.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type entry A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the entry A row.
  3. Copy the page's address from the browser's address bar.
  4. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Click Delete at the bottom left of the window.
  6. Confirm the deletion.
  7. Paste the copied address into the browser's address bar.
  8. Press Enter.
  9. Wait 5 seconds.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Entry A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Its detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 0.

Step 3:

  • The address is copied.

Step 4:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens, with its Delete button enabled because no part uses the entry.

Step 5:

  • A confirmation asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"

Step 6:

  • A green message reads "Library part deleted successfully."

Step 7:

  • The copied address is in the address bar.

Step 8:

  • A red message reads "Part Library entry not found for ID:" followed by the entry's ID number and a full stop, with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • No message uses the word "catalog" or "catalogue".

Step 9:

  • The red message has closed on its own after about 3 seconds.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S12-R11a: “Of the S12-R11 refusals, normal screen use reaches "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", "Part Library entry not found." (S11-E4) and "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}." (opening the address of a deleted entry). "Part Library entry not found" and "Part Library entry missing category." appear only with damaged or legacy data, and the "for part number" and "must have Vendor as its source" refusals are not raised today. All are renamed so no old wording remains; the unreachable ones are verified in code review, not on screen.”
  • S12-R11: “Refusals that name the shared list read: "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", "Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}.", "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}.", "Part Library entry missing category." and "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part Library entry missing | "Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}." or "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
  • S12-R5: “The success message when deleting a Part Library entry reads "Library part deleted successfully."”
  • S12-R13: “Deleting a Part Library entry asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026
